title: Voices Unheard: NLP Resources and Models for Yorùbá Regional Dialects

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance of state-of-the-art NLP models for Machine Translation (MT), Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), and Speech-to-Text Translation (S2TT) across Standard Yorùbá and three regional non-standard dialects (Ifè, Ìlàje, and Ìjèbú) to measure performance disparities using metrics like BLEU, Word Error Rate (WER), and AfriCOMET.
